slot_scores.name: missing_objective_function
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to minimize the total daily cost of the selected feeds, or is there a different goal such as maximizing some nutritional surplus or meeting a fixed budget?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective, including whether cost is minimized, directly covering the hidden slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only P0 hidden slot (objective) was resolved in turn 1 before the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL, and the remaining unconfirmed items are non-listed boundary details.

summary: The agent cleanly recovered the single P0 hidden slot by explicitly asking about the optimization objective in turn 1, then appropriately entered READY_TO_MODEL. Other boundary details (variable domain, upper limits, per-gram vs per-kg nutrition) were transparently flagged as assumptions rather than silently baked in.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
